query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_micro_usd), 0) AS "all_time!: i64",
                  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= ?1 THEN cost_micro_usd END), 0) AS "today!: i64",
                  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= ?2 THEN cost_micro_usd END), 0) AS "week!: i64"
           FROM worker_turns
